Checklist · Schools

Toolkit for schools

A classroom food drive teaches generosity hands-on — and it is often the most joyful one.

Download (.txt)

Checklist

  • Get the principal’s approval
  • Let parents know by email or agenda
  • Prepare one box per class
  • Post the list of requested items
  • Plan a thank-you note for the students
  • Write to us to arrange the pick-up
  • Share a photo (no student faces)

What you can organize

  • Class challenge. Each class fills its own box; the most generous picks the lunchtime music.
  • Lunch boxes with love. Students decorate lunch boxes that go out with the food baskets.
  • A visit from us. A volunteer presents the mission in 20 minutes, adapted to the students’ age.
